beats.say: Cloud folders are handy, but one wrong setting can open a file to the whole internet.
With anyone with the link, if the link is passed on, strangers can open the file too.
The right way: named people only, view-only access and an end date.
Do not upload work files to a personal cloud account. There the organisation cannot protect or recover them.

scenes.title: Share the file
scenes.intro: You need to send the draft budget to an outside partner. Set up the sharing yourself on the cloud drive.

steps.label: Draft budget 2027.xlsx
steps.say: How do you share the file?

actions.label: Share
actions.feedback: Good, the file stays on the work drive. Now look at the sharing settings.

actions.label: Move to my personal cloud
actions.feedback: A personal account is outside the organisation's control. Work files stay on the work drive.

actions.label: Named people only
actions.feedback: Correct. The file opens only for the people you choose.

actions.label: Anyone with the link
actions.feedback: The link can be forwarded or end up in the wrong place. Then anyone can open the file.

actions.label: View, 7 days
actions.feedback: Excellent. The partner can see the file, not change it, and access ends in a week.

actions.label: Edit, no end date
actions.feedback: The partner does not need to edit, and open-ended access stays open for years.

steps.say: An hour later a shared file page opens. Check the address.

actions.label: Sign in
actions.feedback: The domain is not your work drive. A shared file is the excuse to steal the password.

actions.label: Close the tab
actions.feedback: Correct. Open shared files only at disk.rxagentlik.az.

actions.label: Report the site
actions.feedback: Excellent. Reporting the fake page protects colleagues too.

steps.label: My shares: 4 files are open to anyone

actions.label: Close the open links
actions.feedback: Correct. Closing shares you no longer need is the simplest protection.

actions.label: Later
actions.feedback: Every link left open is a new risk every day.

body.text: Salary table: anyone with the link, edit, no end date

cards.explain: A confidential file open to anyone with no end date. Once the link spreads, there is no undo.
Narrow access, view only and an end date. The right setting.

body.text: HR list: everyone in the organisation

cards.explain: A confidential document is not for the whole organisation, only for named people.

body.text: Job advert: anyone with the link

cards.explain: It is public and already on the website. An open link is fine here.

scenes.prompt: Find the right setting for each need.

pairs.left: A partner needs to read a document
A notice published on the website

scenes.explain: Keep sharing as narrow as possible: who, with what rights, for how long.

question.prompt: Can you upload a confidential file to your personal cloud to work from home?

options.label: Yes, my password is strong
options.feedback: A strong password does not put the file back under the organisation's control.

options.label: No, I use the work drive or a way the organisation allows
options.feedback: Correct. On the work drive the file is protected and can be recovered.

options.label: Yes, I will delete it later
options.feedback: A deleted file often stays in the bin and on other devices.

scenes.explain: Work files stay in work systems. If unsure, ask technical support.

points: Never use anyone with the link for confidential files.
Share by name, view only and with an end date.
